section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1976
title: 14 ## Accidental Deaths by Age Group The accidental details reported during 1976 have been further analysed according to the age group of the victims. On the all-India level, the maximum number of accidental deaths occurred in the age group of 18-30 years. This age group accounted for 35.4 percent of the total accidental deaths. The age group which immediately followed was between 30 to 50 years (28.2 percent) 24.1 percent deaths occurred in the age group below 18 years and 12.3 percent deaths occurred in the age group above 50 years.
